select.d: Reads columns from a table; * for all of them.

where.d: Keeps the rows that meet the condition; % stands for any text in LIKE.

conditions.d: List of values, range, empty cell.

orderby.d: Sorts (DESC: descending) and keeps the first rows.

alias.d: Renames a result column or shortens a table name.

groupby.d: One row per group; HAVING filters the groups.

join.d: Matches the rows of two tables.

leftjoin.d: Also keeps rows without a match (empty values).

subquery.d: A query inside another, in parentheses.

with.d: Names an intermediate query, read like a table.

union.d: Appends two results (UNION ALL keeps duplicates).

case.d: Value depending on conditions, like IF.

rownumber.d: Numbers the rows in the chosen order.

rank.d: Rank within each group; ties share a rank.

sumover.d: Running total per group, without grouping rows.

laglead.d: Value from the previous or next row.

insert.d: Adds rows at the end of the table.

insertselect.d: Adds the result of a query.

update.d: Changes the rows that meet WHERE (no WHERE: all).

delete.d: Deletes the rows that meet WHERE (no WHERE: all).

groupconcat.d: Joins the texts of a group with a separator.

substr.d: Extracts part of a text; length.

trim.d: Removes surrounding spaces; replaces a text.

instr.d: Position of a text in another (0: not found).

printf.d: Formats a number or a text.

math.d: Square root, power, round up, round down.

cast.d: Converts to integer, decimal (REAL) or text.

random.d: Random number: sort by it for a sample.

jsongroup.d: Gathers the values of a group into a JSON array.

jsonextract.d: Reads a value from a JSON text.

jsoneach.d: One row per element of a JSON array.

strftime.d: Year (%Y), month (%m), day (%d) of a date.

datediff.d: julianday() of one minus julianday() of the other.

datefilter.d: Dates are written 'YYYY-MM-DD' and compare directly.

names.d: Tables and columns by their on-screen name; in double quotes if it has a space or a symbol.

cell.d: Value of a cell on the displayed sheet; Sheet2!Cell[B3] for another one.

refused.d: CREATE, ALTER, DROP, PRAGMA, ATTACH and internal tables: WITH replaces a view.

rename.d: ALTER TABLE … RENAME TO, the only structure change allowed.

undo.d: Each INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE is undone in one step.

limits.d: 1,000 rows shown; a read stops after 30 s, a write after 2 min (nothing is written).

statements.d: Separated by ; or a blank line; Ctrl+Enter runs the one at the cursor.

tosheet.d: Copy places the result; Reference keeps it linked to the query (F5 refreshes).

favorites.d: ☆ Favorite keeps the query in the workbook.
